body.x: Korea Electronics Show, Korea's largest electronic and IT trade show hosted by Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy(MOTIE) and organized by Korea Electronics Association, Korea Semiconductor Industry Association, and Korea Display Industry Association, ended on Oct.29.

As an event held for four days in COEX, Korean Electronic Industry Exhibition received the review that it led the convergence among different industries like cars and IoT by demonstrating creative idea and innovative IT through a wide array of products and designs.

Global automobile brand Chevrolet showed its electric car Bolt that can run a maximum distance of 380km in one charge and proved its IT convergence technology. In ARTIK hall, 10 finalists from the contest "IoT Innovation Challenge" displayed their IoT platform-based convergence models in smart homes, healthcare, environment, energy, public safety, finance and industry, and smart cars.

In the exhibit Smart factory & Biz Info, finished products, parts, and software from 180 venture companies have been submitted for exhibition. Also, there was consultation for smart factory implementation to help out the smaller companies that cannot afford to build a full-sized production facility.
About 810 companies exhibited this year, which is about 13% increase from last year, and the number of visitors increased about 12% from last year to 67,000 including 3,400 foreign buyers.

Major electronics companies including Haier, China's number one electronics company of 15 years that acquired GE, TESCO, Chang Hong of China, Boulangar SA of France, JiaYou HomeShopping Group of China, and China Mobile International of Hong Kong participated as buyers along with other companies from 20 countries and had 1.86 billion USD worth of consultation with the exhibitors. Next year's show will be held from Oct. 17 to 20.
